tagline: Reimagining insurance, reimagining retirement, reimagining health
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary driver of sustainable and recurring growth trajectory, reflecting commercial strength and customer loyalty in a capital-light model.

kpis.name: Organic Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding foreign exchange and acquisition effects, showing the business's underlying performance.
kpis.description: Aon reports 6% organic revenue growth in 2025, consistent with 2024, driven by new business wins and strong client retention.
kpis.signal: Strong and stable organic growth over two years.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin adjusted to reflect underlying performance, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: Adjusted margin improves from 31.5% to 32.4% in 2025, supported by organic growth and restructuring savings.
kpis.signal: Profitability improvement driven by operational discipline.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after investments, essential for shareholder returns.
kpis.description: FCF reaches $3.2 billion in 2025, up 14%, supported by growth in adjusted earnings.
kpis.signal: Strong ability to convert revenue into cash.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company's operations.
kpis.description: Total revenue reaches $17.2 billion in 2025, up 9%, driven by organic growth and the acquisition of NFP.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth supported by the NFP acquisition.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improves to 25.3% in 2025 from 24.4% in 2024, despite the addition of NFP and declining fiduciary income.
kpis.signal: Improved operational efficiency despite NFP integration.

kpis.name: Human Capital Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from talent, health, and retirement management services.
kpis.description: Human Capital segment revenue reaches $5.9 billion, up 13%, driven by growth in health and retirement.

kpis.name: Risk Capital Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from risk management brokerage and advisory services.
kpis.description: Risk Capital segment generates $11.3 billion, up 7%, driven by commercial brokerage and reinsurance solutions.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in a mature segment.

kpis.name: Adjusted EPS
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings per share, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EPS reaches $17.07 in 2025, up 9% from $15.60 in 2024.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EPS growth aligned with margin and revenue growth.

kpis.name: Human Capital Adjusted Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin of the Human Capital segment.
kpis.description: Human Capital adjusted margin improves from 29.5% to 32.2% in 2025, driven by growth and streamlining.

kpis.name: Risk Capital Adjusted Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin of the Risk Capital segment.
kpis.description: Risk Capital adjusted margin slightly declines to 34.3% in 2025 from 34.6% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Slight margin pressure despite a strong base.
